import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time: pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # ---- strictly historical data ----
    filtered_order_items = order_items[order_items["ts"] <= seed_time].copy()
    valid_order_ids = filtered_order_items["order_id"].unique()

    filtered_orders = orders[orders["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids)].copy()
    filtered_reviews = reviews[
        reviews["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids)
        & (reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time)
    ].copy()
    filtered_payments = payments[
        payments["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids)
        & (payments["ts"] <= seed_time)
    ].copy()

    output = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))

    # ---- 1. Core order item features ----
    agg = filtered_order_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_sold=("order_item_id", "count"),
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        first_sale_ts=("ts", "min"),
        last_sale_ts=("ts", "max"),
    ).reset_index()

    agg["days_since_first_sale"] = (
        (seed_time - agg["first_sale_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400
    )
    agg["days_since_last_sale"] = (
        (seed_time - agg["last_sale_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400
    )
    agg["sales_frequency"] = agg["total_units_sold"] / agg[
        "days_since_first_sale"
    ].replace(0, np.nan)

    def window_sales(window_days):
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=window_days)
        return filtered_order_items[
            filtered_order_items["ts"] >= cutoff
        ].groupby("product_id")["order_item_id"].count().rename(
            f"units_sold_last_{window_days}d"
        )

    for window in [30, 90, 180, 365]:
        agg = agg.merge(window_sales(window), on="product_id", how="left")

    def avg_interval(group):
        if len(group) < 2:
            return np.nan
        intervals = group["ts"].sort_values().diff().dropna()
        return intervals.dt.total_seconds().mean() / 86400

    intervals = filtered_order_items.groupby("product_id").apply(
        avg_interval
    ).rename("avg_days_between_sales").reset_index()
    agg = agg.merge(intervals, on="product_id", how="left")

    output = output.join(agg.set_index("product_id"), how="left")

    fill_core = {
        "total_units_sold": 0, "total_orders": 0, "total_sellers": 0,
        "total_revenue": 0.0, "total_freight": 0.0, "avg_price": 0.0,
        "avg_freight": 0.0, "days_since_first_sale": 730.0,
        "days_since_last_sale": 730.0, "sales_frequency": 0.0,
        "units_sold_last_30d": 0, "units_sold_last_90d": 0,
        "units_sold_last_180d": 0, "units_sold_last_365d": 0,
        "avg_days_between_sales": 730.0,
    }
    output.fillna(value=fill_core, inplace=True)
    output.drop(columns=["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"], inplace=True, errors="ignore")

    # ---- 2. Order status & delivery features (status as of seed_time) ----
    oi_orders = filtered_order_items.merge(filtered_orders, on="order_id", how="left")

    # Reconstruct status known at seed_time from timestamps (order_status column
    # reflects the *current* status and would leak future info).
    delivered_cust = oi_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"]
    delivered_carrier = oi_orders["order_delivered_carrier_date"]
    approved = oi_orders["order_approved_at"]
    purchase = oi_orders["order_purchase_timestamp"]

    status = np.where(
        delivered_cust.notna() & (delivered_cust <= seed_time), "delivered",
        np.where(
            delivered_carrier.notna() & (delivered_carrier <= seed_time), "shipped",
            np.where(
                approved.notna() & (approved <= seed_time), "approved",
                np.where(purchase.notna() & (purchase <= seed_time), "purchased", "unknown"),
            ),
        ),
    )
    oi_orders["status_at_seed"] = status

    status_counts = oi_orders.groupby(["product_id", "status_at_seed"])[
        "order_id"
    ].nunique().unstack(fill_value=0)
    status_ratios = status_counts.div(status_counts.sum(axis=1), axis=0).fillna(0)
    status_counts.columns = [f"order_count_{s}" for s in status_counts.columns]
    status_ratios.columns = [f"order_ratio_{s}" for s in status_ratios.columns]
    order_status_features = pd.concat([status_counts, status_ratios], axis=1).reset_index()

    # Delivery performance: only orders DELIVERED BEFORE seed_time
    delivered = oi_orders[
        (oi_orders["status_at_seed"] == "delivered")
        & (delivered_cust <= seed_time)
    ].copy()
    if len(delivered) > 0:
        delivered["delivery_days"] = (
            delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"]
            - delivered["order_purchase_timestamp"]
        ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400
        delivered["is_late"] = (
            delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"]
            > delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
        )
        delivery_agg = delivered.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_delivery_days=("delivery_days", "mean"),
            pct_late_deliveries=("is_late", "mean"),
        ).reset_index()
    else:
        delivery_agg = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=["product_id", "avg_delivery_days", "pct_late_deliveries"]
        )

    order_features = order_status_features.merge(delivery_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    output = output.join(order_features.set_index("product_id"), how="left")

    # Global defaults computed only from orders delivered before seed_time
    global_delivery_days = 14.0
    global_late_pct = 0.1
    glob_delivered = filtered_orders[
        filtered_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()
        & (filtered_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] <= seed_time)
    ]
    if len(glob_delivered) > 0:
        global_delivery_days = (
            (glob_delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"]
             - glob_delivered["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400
        ).mean()
        global_late_pct = (
            glob_delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"]
            > glob_delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
        ).mean()
        if np.isnan(global_delivery_days):
            global_delivery_days = 14.0
        if np.isnan(global_late_pct):
            global_late_pct = 0.1

    fill_order = {
        col: 0 for col in output.columns
        if col.startswith("order_count_") or col.startswith("order_ratio_")
    }
    fill_order["avg_delivery_days"] = global_delivery_days
    fill_order["pct_late_deliveries"] = global_late_pct
    output.fillna(value=fill_order, inplace=True)

    # ---- 3. Review features (only reviews created before seed_time) ----
    oi_reviews = filtered_order_items.merge(filtered_reviews, on="order_id", how="left")

    review_agg = oi_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_id", "count"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
        max_review_score=("review_score", "max"),
    ).reset_index()

    five_star = oi_reviews[oi_reviews["review_score"] == 5].groupby("product_id")[
        "review_id"
    ].count().rename("five_star")
    one_star = oi_reviews[oi_reviews["review_score"] == 1].groupby("product_id")[
        "review_id"
    ].count().rename("one_star")
    review_agg = review_agg.merge(five_star, on="product_id", how="left").merge(
        one_star, on="product_id", how="left"
    )
    review_agg["five_star_ratio"] = review_agg["five_star"] / review_agg[
        "total_reviews"
    ].replace(0, np.nan)
    review_agg["one_star_ratio"] = review_agg["one_star"] / review_agg[
        "total_reviews"
    ].replace(0, np.nan)
    review_agg.drop(columns=["five_star", "one_star"], inplace=True)

    output = output.join(review_agg.set_index("product_id"), how="left")

    global_avg_rev, global_min_rev, global_max_rev = 3.0, 1.0, 5.0
    if len(filtered_reviews) > 0:
        global_avg_rev = filtered_reviews["review_score"].mean()
        global_min_rev = filtered_reviews["review_score"].min()
        global_max_rev = filtered_reviews["review_score"].max()

    output.fillna(value={
        "total_reviews": 0,
        "avg_review_score": global_avg_rev,
        "min_review_score": global_min_rev,
        "max_review_score": global_max_rev,
        "five_star_ratio": 0.0,
        "one_star_ratio": 0.0,
    }, inplace=True)

    # ---- 4. Payment features (only payments with ts <= seed_time) ----
    order_payments = filtered_payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        num_payments=("payment_sequential", "count"),
    ).reset_index()

    if len(filtered_payments) > 0:
        payment_types = filtered_payments.pivot_table(
            index="order_id", columns="payment_type",
            values="payment_sequential", aggfunc="count", fill_value=0,
        )
        payment_types.columns = [f"pay_type_{c}" for c in payment_types.columns]
        order_payments = order_payments.merge(
            payment_types, on="order_id", how="left"
        ).fillna(0)

    oi_pay = filtered_order_items.merge(order_payments, on="order_id", how="left")
    pay_agg = oi_pay.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_total_payment=("total_payment_value", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("avg_installments", "mean"),
        avg_payments_per_order=("num_payments", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()

    pay_type_cols = [c for c in order_payments.columns if c.startswith("pay_type_")]
    if pay_type_cols:
        pay_type_totals = oi_pay.groupby("product_id")[pay_type_cols].sum().reset_index()
        total_pay_counts = pay_type_totals[pay_type_cols].sum(axis=1)
        for col in pay_type_cols:
            pay_type_totals[f"{col}_ratio"] = pay_type_totals[col] / total_pay_counts.replace(0, np.nan)
        pay_type_totals.drop(columns=pay_type_cols, inplace=True)
        pay_agg = pay_agg.merge(pay_type_totals, on="product_id", how="left")

    output = output.join(pay_agg.set_index("product_id"), how="left")

    global_avg_pay, global_avg_inst, global_avg_pay_count = 0.0, 1.0, 1.0
    if len(order_payments) > 0:
        global_avg_pay = order_payments["total_payment_value"].mean()
        global_avg_inst = order_payments["avg_installments"].mean()
        global_avg_pay_count = order_payments["num_payments"].mean()

    fill_pay = {
        "avg_total_payment": global_avg_pay,
        "avg_installments": global_avg_inst,
        "avg_payments_per_order": global_avg_pay_count,
    }
    for col in output.columns:
        if col.startswith("pay_type_") and col.endswith("_ratio"):
            fill_pay[col] = 0.0
    output.fillna(value=fill_pay, inplace=True)

    # ---- final cleanup ----
    for col in output.columns:
        if pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(output[col]):
            output[col] = output[col].astype(np.float64)

    output = output.reindex(entity_ids)
    return output
